style_bible.tone: Grounded, damp, and quietly desperate; dread comes from tide tables, not monsters
style_bible.narrative_voice: Second person, present tense, close and plain
style_bible.faction_language_notes: Priests speak in weights and measures; the Chain speaks in tides; clerks cite forms
style_bible.naming_conventions: Short Saxon-sounding surnames, ward names from what drowned there
style_bible.description_requirements: One concrete sensory detail per beat; name the material before the mood
examples: The ledger's spine has swollen with damp. When you open it the pages part with a wet sigh.
Ysolde weighs the coin on her palm as if it were a sin, then pockets it anyway.
anti_examples: An eldritch sense of dread washed over you as the ancient tome revealed its secrets.
style_bible.art_direction: Painterly, low horizon, wet greys and rust with one cold blue accent
